purpose: Reviewed compatibility: caller-thread persistence, opt-in lossless transport, draft-first scheduling and source-bound writing/review partitions. Original validate_audit remains unchanged; old full audits retain every semantic gate. Exact native packets, prose and cached audits are revalidated. Partial writing partitions never count as a complete draft or an accepted audit. Reviews must cover all original propositions and preserve negative verdicts. Reviewed 2026-11-11: output-locator-only repairs preserve all semantic verdicts and re-run the unchanged validators; failed responses retain specific diagnostic codes; same-proposal deferred receipts merge completed slices. No old acceptance gate is waived. Canonical JSON slice hashes and guarded parent-proof/proposal-identical old-slice rebinding retain full slice validation. Strict mode retains prior validators. Opt-in core-semantic review has a separate file-bound policy and never migrates strict judgments as semantic acceptance.
